info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Knowledge Asset By Param1-spec
info.description: The Knowledge Asset Retrieval API enables users to access specific knowledge assets based on a unique parameter. Leveraging this API, clients can easily fetch detailed information about knowledge resources that are tailored to their requirements. This functionality supports various use cases, from improving customer service to enhancing product offerings within the banking sector. Typically, business analysts and developers utilize this API to integrate knowledge asset data into applications or analytics tools.

get.description: Fetch details of the specified knowledge exchange asset identified by RES-100045. This endpoint allows users to access specific information regarding the asset, including its properties and usage context.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve specific knowledge asset information related to the knowledge exchange identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required fields are correctly populated to facilitate a successful query.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data retrieved.

GetKnowledgeAssetByParam1Request.description: Request body for the GET operation on the knowledge exchange resource with identifier RES-100045. This schema specifies the expected structure and format of the request data.
